name: Ochita JK no Yuuwaku Ran'en
source:
"Ah, a new face. You're so much younger than the others!"
After a night out drinking my boss comped me a hotel room in the city.
It was a fancy suite, way better than anything I could afford normally.
So I was kind of shocked to see a young woman blowing a guy.
They'd rented a room here for privacy, and in fact the whole hotel
was a hub for such activity. I tried not to stare. The girl noticed
me anyway, and smiled wide. Leered, more like. She barely had
the cum wiped off her face when she asked me,

"Hey oniichan. Wanna be my friend too?"

I saw the seedy underbelly of the city inside that hotel. This is my story. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE132219.html] DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“哎呀，新面孔。你比其他人年轻多了！”
一次酒后，老板送我一间市内旅馆房间。
这是间豪华套房，比我平时能负担的好得多。
因此，当我看见一个年轻女人给男人口交时，很是震惊。
他们租房是为了隐私，事实上整家旅馆都是这种活动的中心。我尽量不盯着看，但女孩还是注意到了我，咧嘴笑了起来，更像是在淫笑。她脸上的精液还没擦干，就问我：

“喂，哥哥，也想和我做朋友吗？”

我在那家旅馆看见了城市肮脏的底层。这就是我的故事。
